jobs.label: Platform Engineer — states one bar explicitly and leaves the rest bare
jobs.location: London, United Kingdom (hybrid, two days a week in the office)
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Platform Engineer to look after the clusters and the pipelines our product teams deploy onto.

What we are looking for:
- Kubernetes
- Terraform in production, not just in a home lab
- Docker
- 5+ years of professional infrastructure experience

Nice to have: AWS
Also useful: 3+ years of Kubernetes experience

You must have the right to work in the UK.
